lead_raw_text:
The structure of U9Sb3N12 (reduced formula U3SbN4) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral N centers coordinated by three Sb and three U neighbors, alongside octahedral U centers coordinated by six N neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between N-centered octahedra and between U-centered octahedra, though these selected patterns do not assert an exclusive sharing type for all polyhedra.
